people.name: Arabah
people.line: A desert region in the Jordan Valley and southward.

people.name: David
people.line: Anointed king of Israel, ancestor of Jesus Christ

people.name: Jeshimon
people.line: A wilderness near Ziph, where David hid from Saul

people.name: Maon
people.line: A city in Judah; home of Nabal and Abigail

people.name: Saul
people.line: First king of Israel, anointed by Samuel

people.name: Ziph
people.line: A town in Judah where David hid from Saul

translations.web: They arose, and went to Ziph before Saul: but David and his men were in the wilderness of Maon, in the Arabah on the south of the desert.
translations.bsb: So they set out and went to Ziph ahead of Saul. Now David and his men were in the Wilderness of Maon in the Arabah south of Jeshimon,
translations.kjv: And they arose, and went to Ziph before Saul: but David and his men were in the wilderness of Maon, in the plain on the south of Jeshimon.
translations.asv: And they arose, and went to Ziph before Saul: but David and his men were in the wilderness of Maon, in the Arabah on the south of the desert.
